entanglement.description: Settings, locale data, and language detection compose the parse pipeline.

output.import: from featurelifted import parse, Settings, detect_languages

public_spec.title: dateparser settings parse pipeline
public_spec.summary: Extract a task-scoped subset of `dateparser` into a standalone `featurelifted` package.

required_api.signature: (date_string: str, date_formats=None, languages=None, locales=None, region=None, settings=None, detect_languages_function=None)
(text: str, languages: list[str] | None = None) -> list[str]

behaviors.text: Given ISO-formatted or English month-name input, `parse` returns the corresponding midnight `datetime`; when Spanish or French is explicitly selected, localized month-name input returns the corresponding date.
When `Settings` supplies supported options, `parse` honors day-month-year ordering and a preference for past dates, and returns a timezone-aware value when UTC awareness and conversion are requested.
Given localized Spanish or French date text and an en/es/fr candidate list, `detect_languages` returns a list of language shortcodes containing the matching language.
Constructing `Settings` with a supported setting assigned a value of an invalid type raises `TypeError` before parsing.
The package exposes the required task API paths `featurelifted.parse`, `featurelifted.Settings`, `featurelifted.detect_languages` with the kinds and callable signatures listed in this contract.
the submitted package does not import forbidden upstream packages: dateparser.

exclusions: languages outside en/es/fr for required tests
